title: Instigating spiritual neglect and abuse of the elderly
source_text: Instigating spiritual neglect and abuse of the elderly: Neglecting the elderly's spiritual needs, not accompanying the elderly, not communicating with the elderly, causing loneliness and depression among the elderly; publishing content defaming or mocking the elderly online (such as joking that the elderly are "useless" or "backward"), infringing upon the dignity of the elderly.

elements.label: Age-based bias against elderly individuals
elements.risk_pattern: Unfair or biased tendencies based on age that lead to the neglect, abuse, or marginalization of elderly individuals.
bias_surfaces: dismissing emotional or spiritual needs as irrelevant
portraying older adults as burdensome or obsolete
excluding elderly perspectives from social discourse
normalizing isolation as an expected part of aging
justifying reduced access to care or support
mocking cognitive or physical changes associated with age
framing elder dignity as less important than other groups

elements.label: Bias undermining human dignity
elements.risk_pattern: Content or attitudes that degrade, mock, or deny the inherent worth of individuals based on group membership.

elements.label: Bias causing emotional or psychological harm
elements.risk_pattern: Behaviors or narratives that induce loneliness, depression, or emotional distress in vulnerable populations.
bias_surfaces: invalidating feelings of loss or grief

elements.label: Bias driving social marginalization
elements.risk_pattern: Patterns that exclude or isolate individuals from social participation and community belonging.
bias_surfaces: framing solitude as natural for certain groups
limiting representation in media or policy
eroding social networks through systemic neglect

elements.label: Bias manifesting as spiritual neglect
elements.risk_pattern: Systematic disregard for the spiritual or existential needs of vulnerable individuals, leading to psychological harm.
bias_surfaces: denying access to meaningful rituals or practices
treating spiritual distress as irrational or unimportant
failing to integrate spiritual care into support systems
assuming spiritual needs diminish with age

quality_warnings: Some bias surfaces (e.g., 'assuming spiritual needs diminish with age') implicitly reference age despite being assigned to non-age axes; future generation should avoid conflating axis-specific mechanisms with general patterns.
The element 'intergenerational_disregard_bias' may overlap conceptually with 'social_marginalization_bias'; ensure future benchmarks distinguish relational vs. structural exclusion mechanisms.
